Name: AT - Travelling Cart Farmhouse
Author: Lavliette
Description:
Changes your farmhouse into the merchants travelling cart with an autumn theme.

Pros: 
Looks very cute in fall <3
The curtain door and the wood pile should work as intended
Made with AT so you don't have to look at it in other seasons :)

Cons:
You can walk on the flowers and the path near the pumpkin will float above you
Why? Cause Aesthetics >>>>> functionality k thx bye <3
